people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses stretched out his hand toward the sky, and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt for three days.
translations.bsb: So Moses stretched out his hand toward heaven, and total darkness covered all the land of Egypt for three days.
translations.kjv: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven; and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days:
